lesson.title: AI is guessing the next word
lesson.idea: A chatbot (a large language model) writes by guessing the next word, again and again.

diagrams.alt: A sentence branches to three possible next words. Mat is likeliest at 41%, then sofa at 22% and floor at 9%.

steps: Your text is cut into small pieces (tokens).
The model scores every possible next piece.
It picks one, with a little randomness.
It adds that piece and repeats.
lesson.analogy: Predictive text on your phone, trained on a huge amount of writing.
lesson.breaks: Your phone looks at a word or two. A model weighs thousands at once.
lesson.why: It predicts what sounds right, not what is true, so any AI programme needs checking steps.

quiz.q: Why can it sound sure and still be wrong?
quiz.a: It predicts what sounds likely, not what is true.
